patch_description: This redesign organizes rebalancing as a staged planning pipeline with dedicated helpers for permutation inversion, batched capacity-constrained packing, replica allocation, and result materialization. The expensive group/physical-expert packing loops are vectorized across all MoE layers: only one loop per item position remains, avoiding Python-level loops over layers and packs. Replica allocation retains the greedy max-per-replica policy while using batched tensor operations. The resulting implementation preserves the original public inputs and outputs while substantially reducing CPU interpreter overhead and temporary data flow complexity.
